title: Deltarune + Undertale Music
description: Replaces the Minecraft OST with music from Deltarune and Undertale
body:
VERY BUGGY AND IN BETA! Final Version releasing soon!

This resource pack replaces **every** Minecraft song with music from Deltarune + Undertale.
